note: Meaning drift (negation) that pe check does not see; only the entailment judge can catch it.
input: Not every patient in the trial responded to the 20 mg dose.
rewrite: The 20 mg dose did not work for every patient in the trial.

drift.rewrite: No patient in the trial responded to the 20 mg dose.
drift.reason: 'Not every' (some did not) became 'no patient' (none did): both keep a negation, so check sees no change.
